2609.31568.title: DeepEdu-v1: Efficient and Scalable Agentic LLMs for Vietnamese Education
2609.31568.paper_summary: AI tutoring could markedly improve learning outcomes for students in developing regions such as Vietnam, yet the two obvious paths both fall short. Cloud assistants such as ChatGPT route sensitive student data to foreign servers---violating data-sovereignty laws such as Vietnam's Decree 53---and, pre-trained on Western-centric corpora, are not organized around the national textbook curriculum, so their knowledge of local content is unsystematic and frequently hallucinated. Self-hosting an open model keeps data on-premise but hits a two-fold wall: post-training quantization (AWQ, GPTQ) tames the static weight footprint, yet the dynamic KV cache and prefill latency of long tutoring contexts still cause out-of-memory failures and slow responses on consumer GPUs, while the model keeps hallucinating on region-specific material. We present DeepEdu-v1, an AI-tutoring system for Vietnamese education built on SCALE (Self-improving Context-Aware Learning Engine), a framework with two innovations. First, a long-context inference engine amortizes token selection from per-sub-chunk to per-cluster granularity; on long-context retrieval it issues x7.7 fewer retrieval calls than a state-of-the-art selective-attention baseline, cutting prefill latency (TTFT) by roughly 35% while matching or improving task accuracy. Second, a self-improving agentic layer continuously curates a verified playbook from past interactions instead of fine-tuning, a design intended to progressively reduce reliance on dominant-language priors as trustworthy local knowledge accumulates. In its deployed configuration, DeepEdu achieves a nearly x2 TTFT speedup over standard vLLM serving and lifts agentic accuracy from 70.0% to 79.5% on complex tasks, with the strongest per-track gains across financial-reasoning and interactive-agent benchmarks.
2609.31568.paper_summary_zh: AI 輔導可以顯著改善越南等發展中地區學生的學習成果，但這兩條明顯的路徑都不盡如人意。雲端助手如 ChatGPT 將敏感的學生數據傳送到外國伺服器——違反了越南的第 53 號法令等數據主權法律——而且，由於預訓練於以西方為中心的語料庫，這些助手並未圍繞國家教科書課程進行組織，因此它們對當地內容的知識是不系統的，並且經常出現幻覺。自我托管開放模型可以將數據保留在本地，但面臨兩重障礙：後訓練量化（AWQ，GPTQ）雖然可以降低靜態權重的佔用，但長期輔導上下文的動態 KV 緩存和預填延遲仍然導致消費者 GPU 的內存溢出故障和響應緩慢，同時模型在區域特定材料上仍然出現幻覺。我們提出了 DeepEdu-v1，一個基於 SCALE（自我改善的上下文感知學習引擎）的越南教育 AI 輔導系統，該框架具有兩項創新。首先，長上下文推理引擎將每個子塊的標記選擇從每個子塊的粒度擴展到每個集群的粒度；在長上下文檢索中，它的檢索調用比最先進的選擇性注意基準少了 7.7 倍，將預填延遲（TTFT）減少約 35%，同時保持或提高任務準確性。其次，自我改善的代理層不斷從過去的互動中策劃經過驗證的操作手冊，而不是進行微調，這一設計旨在隨著可信的本地知識的積累，逐步減少對主導語言先驗的依賴。在其部署配置中，DeepEdu 在標準 vLLM 服務上實現了近 2 倍的 TTFT 加速，並將複雜任務的代理準確率從 70.0% 提升至 79.5%，在金融推理和互動代理基準中取得了最強的每個軌道增益。
